reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Before resending anything, I looked into transfer TRF-INV-88, and Access Bank itself confirms the payment was successful — the ₦250,000 was credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 UTC. Our dashboard incorrectly shows it as "failed," but the bank's record is authoritative.

Please don't treat this as a missing payment yet: kindly check your Access Bank account, or ask your bank to trace the credit using session ID 000014261121140211000088.

I have deliberately NOT resent the transfer, since the bank confirms the original was credited — resending would mean a duplicate ₦250,000 payment. If the funds genuinely cannot be traced with that session ID, let me know what your bank says and we'll take it from there.

[after the person answered]

Good afternoon Chidi,

I re-checked with Access Bank directly and their answer is unchanged: the ₦250,000 was credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 15:02 Nigerian time, with session/trace ID 000014261121140211000088. The bank confirms the money landed in the account we sent it to.

I understand you can't see it, but I'm not able to resend — a second transfer would send another ₦250,000 to the same account, and if the first credit is there you'd be paid twice. That's a risk I can't take while the bank is confirming the credit.

What will resolve this quickly:

1. Raise a formal trace with Access Bank (branch or customer care) — not just a check of the app. Give them:
   - Amount: ₦250,000
   - Date/time: 21 November 2026, approx. 15:02 WAT
   - Session ID: 000014261121140211000088
   - Expected in: Access Bank account 0234567891 (Chidi's Farm Produce)
2. Please double-check that 0234567891 is exactly your account number — any difference in the digits would explain why you can't see it.
3. Ask the branch to check the account ledger directly; inward credits sometimes take a day or two to reflect in the mobile app.

If Access Bank's formal trace confirms no credit was received, send me their written response and I will escalate it internally right away and make it right. Until we have that, I have to rely on the bank's confirmation rather than resend.
